summary: Tuned circuits, op-amps, phase-locked loops, synthesizers and mixers, then the exam's schematic figures.

blocks.title: Resonance
items: Reactance: a coil's opposition to AC (XL) rises with frequency; a capacitor's (XC) falls.
Resonance: the one frequency where XL = XC. They act 180° apart, so they cancel and leave R.
Phase: coil current lags 90°, capacitor current leads 90°. At resonance voltage and current are in phase: power factor 1.

blocks.title: Q and the tank
items: Q, quality factor (series: XL÷R): coil voltage ≈ Q × applied voltage. Q of 100, 1 V in: about 100 V. Resonance is how voltage across series reactances beats the applied voltage.
Tank circuit: coil and capacitor in parallel, with current circulating inside.

blocks.title: Op-amps
items: Op-amp (operational amplifier): amplifies the difference between its inverting (−) and non-inverting (+) inputs. Open-loop gain is huge; the output stops at the supply rails.
External feedback, output to inverting input, sets closed-loop gain.
Inverting gain = −Rf÷Rin. 100 kΩ÷10 kΩ: −10, 10 times bigger and upside down.

items.def: voltage-controlled oscillator, tuned by a varactor diode.
phase-locked loop, a servo loop of phase detector, low-pass filter and VCO. Its error voltage adjusts the varactor, locking the VCO to a frequency standard.
direct digital synthesizer: phase comparator, look-up table, DAC (digital-to-analog converter), low-pass antialias filter.
gives sum, difference and both inputs. RF 200 MHz, local oscillator 150 MHz: 50, 150, 200 and 350 MHz at the IF (intermediate frequency) output.
conducts when its anode is more positive, keeping about 0.7 V across it. Lamps light only through forward-biased diodes.
the Zener holds its base; its emitter sits about 0.7 V lower.

blocks.title: Exam traps
items: Parallel impedance isn't low: it's about R, its maximum.
Gain isn't set by an internal network, supply voltage or slew rate. Output to + is positive feedback.
Impurities: PLL broadband noise, DDS spurs at discrete frequencies.
Coupling capacitor open: no amplification, DC normal.
3D9: D1 and D2 aren't reversed, R1 isn't too low, TR1 needn't be PNP.
